title: lycopodium complanatum subsp. alpinum
intro: Lycopodium complanatum subsp. alpinum, commonly known as Alpine Club Moss, is a type of lycopodium plant that belongs to the family Lycopodiaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Club Moss include stimulating digestion, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may help to mitigate various health conditions.
